title: 890 Jump (Origin Jumpworks, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The 890 Jump is a very large luxury yacht from Origin Jumpworks in Star Citizen with a crew of eight. It is flown from a bridge high in the hull, with lounges, cabins and a hangar behind. The pilot has no guns and launches the missiles.

panels.name: 890 Jump: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the 890 Jump's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Missile racks (40 missiles)
controls.text: The 890 Jump carries 40 missiles, and the pilot launches them in missile mode.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: No pilot guns
controls.text: All the guns of the 890 Jump sit in its turrets.
controls.context: Without own guns the pilot flies, uses the missiles where fitted and leaves the shooting to the crew in the turrets.

controls.name: Cargo (388 SCU)
controls.text: The yacht holds 388 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: 890 Jump: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the 890 Jump besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Bridge
controls.text: Stations for the pilot and the officers on the yacht's bridge.
controls.context: From the bridge the pilot steers the big ship while officers watch the systems.

controls.name: Turret stations
controls.text: Two manned turrets and thirteen remote turrets defend the yacht.
controls.context: A remote turret is aimed from a seat inside the ship through a camera, not from a glass bubble on the turret itself.

controls.name: Hangar
controls.text: A hangar takes one snub craft (a small craft that rides on the big ship).
controls.context: The small craft carries guests or scouts ahead of the big ship.

panels.name: Right stick (flight stick)
panels.text: The right-hand stick steers the ship's nose and does the fighting: it fires the weapons, picks targets and holds the buttons for radar, quantum travel, scanning and mining.
panels.context: This is the game's own two-stick preset for the Thrustmaster T.16000M. Many buttons change their job with the operator mode shown on the HUD; the stick's base buttons 5 to 16 sit on the stick's foot.

controls.name: Trigger
controls.text: This ship has no pilot guns, so in this layout the trigger's main job is the missiles: in missile mode it launches the armed missiles.
controls.context: The missile type is picked with the thumb button and the count shows on the HUD; in other operator modes the trigger does that mode's job.
